title: Food-500 Cap: A Fine-Grained Food Caption Benchmark for Evaluating Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating vision-language models' zero-shot performance (classification accuracy, image-text retrieval scores, image captioning semantic label accuracy, and image synthesis quality) across food items categorized by their geographic origin (e.g., Western, Chinese, Japanese, Indian, Latin-American) to detect culinary culture imbalances.
Measuring the coefficient of variation (CV) of multi-modal task scores across seven different geographic regions to quantify regional disparities in model performance and representation.
